title: Strava Segment PR Attempt Density
dataSources: Rides (`ride:session`), charge sessions (`ride:charge`), ride exports (`ride:export`), surf forecasts (`surf:forecast`), ride incidents (`ride:incident`), segment efforts (`fitness:segment`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sports telemetry — Onewheel ride exports, legacy Boosted board logs, Surfline forecast snapshots, and Strava segment efforts — streamed to Splunk HEC via vendor exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fitness:segment segment_name=* is_pr=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(is_pr="yes",1,0))) as matched by segment_name
| eval a_personal_record_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_personal_record_pct
description: Measures the percentage of segment attempts that end with a personal record by Strava segment.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which Strava segment are helping or hurting segment attempts.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a personal record` on `fitness:segment` events and summarize the hit rate by `segment_name`.
visualization: Table of Strava segment with percentage of segment attempts ending with a personal record.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how often a personal record happens for each Strava segment so you can see where segment attempts go smoothly or get stuck.
